get.description: Retrieve paginated orders with filters such as status, user, product, and date range. Also syncs settlement status with Cashfree API.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Filter by user ID (from orders table)

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter by start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be used with endDate.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter by end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be used with startDate.

error.example: An error occurred while retrieving the orders. Please try again.
